 The NBA is back, and DraftKings Sportsbook is giving new customers an exciting way to celebrate opening day. Bet $5 and get $200 in bonus bets , plus three months of free NBA League Pass, when you sign up with DraftKings and take advantage of the latest welcome offer.
 Opening night features a trio of intriguing matchups, starting with the Boston Celtics taking on Cade Cunningham and the Detroit Pistons before LeBron James and Jaylen Brown make their debut for the Philadelphia 76ers against the defending champs, the New York Knicks. 
 The night wraps up with a Western Conference showdown between reigning MVP, Shai Gilgeous-Alexander and the Oklahoma City Thunder facing Victor Wembanyama and the San Antonio Spurs. With championship contenders and rising stars taking the court, there are plenty of lines to wager on as the new NBA season gets underway.
 Make the most of opening night with DraftKings Sportsbook. New customers can sign up on DraftKings to unlock $200 in Bonus Bets after a $5 wager and enjoy three months of free NBA League Pass, bringing even more basketball to follow throughout the season.
   How to Sign up for DraftKings Sportsbook and Claim the New User Bonus
 Sign up for a new DraftKings Sportsbook account. 
 Enter all required information, including name, email and the last four digits of your Social Security number. 
 Agree to DraftKings' terms and conditions. 
 Make a deposit and opt in to the NBA League Pass promotion. 
 Make a wager of at least $5.
